n_assessed.short_description: Number of students assessed for immunization status.
n_assessed.long_description: Count of students whose immunization status was assessed at the reporting level; the denominator for that record's percentages.

pct_exempt_total.long_name: Percent of students with any vaccination exemption
pct_exempt_total.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
pct_exempt_total.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, as reported in the Maine School Vaccination Rates workbooks.
pct_exempt_total.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

pct_exempt_medical.long_name: Percent of students with a medical vaccination exemption
pct_exempt_medical.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.

pct_exempt_medical.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

pct_90_day.long_name: Percent of students in the 90-day provisional period

pct_90_day.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students were in the 90-day provisional period.

pct_missing.long_name: Percent of students with no immunization record on file

pct_missing.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students had no immunization record on file.

pct_dtap.long_name: Percent of students up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination
pct_dtap.short_description: Percentage of assessed school students who are up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination.
pct_dtap.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
pct_dtap.statement: In {location}, {value}% of school students were up to date for DTaP/Tdap vaccination.
